Initial run followed advertised links after OPM and other homepage challenges; no challenge was solved or bypassed. OPM remains ACCESS_POLICY_REVIEW. Audit helper now stops follow-up discovery on challenge.

Robots evaluation conservatively honors matching Disallow from any agent group, including groups not applicable to this audit user-agent. ROBOTS_RESTRICTED means skipped by audit policy, not a claim of universal prohibition.
XML rechecks use strict System.Xml with DTD disabled. No XML repair or certificate bypass performed. Counts and three link/date samples retained, no article bodies.
